services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: The Center for Photographic Art in Carmel, California, is set to impress audiences with its upcoming exciting photography exhibitions. From solo shows to themed exhibitions and calls for entry, these exhibitions showcase the diverse talents and perspectives of photographers from around the world, including our amazing members! With a commitment to fostering artistic expression and appreciation of the photographic arts, CPA remains a prominent beacon of photographic creativity and inspiration, connecting California’s Central Coast with the global photographic community. blurb: Welcome to the Center for Photographic Art (CPA) - Tracing our roots back to the Friends of Photography, founded in 1967, we remain the second oldest members’ photography gallery space in the country. A short walk from Ocean Avenue in Carmel, California brings you to the venerable gallery originally occupied by the Friends of Photography, launched by iconic artists Ansel Adams, Cole Weston, and Wynn Bullock.
